top_findings: All canonicals, hreflang and og:url point to vincent-desbrosses.com, which does not resolve (NXDOMAIN)
generateMetadata lives in the layout, so every sub-page canonicalises to the locale homepage
No valid JSON-LD: Person schema emitted as <meta name="application/ld+json"> instead of a <script> tag
HTTP 500 on unmatched dotted paths (/llms.txt, /ads.txt) from an unvalidated [locale] dynamic import
Only 3 crawlable hrefs site-wide; all social links and the CV are buttons using window.open()
quick_wins: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in Vercel (5 min, fixes the dead-domain issue site-wide)
Read the French metadata that already exists in src/i18n/fr.json but is never used
Add a locale allowlist + notFound() guard (3 lines) to eliminate all 500s
Convert navigation buttons to real <a href> anchors (fixes SEO entity signals and WCAG together)
Wrap the FAQ block in its own H2 so it stops nesting under 'Journey'

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All redirects single-hop
Immutable caching on hashed static assets
Brotli compression
HTTPS + HSTS enforced
Correct viewport meta

findings.title: Site-wide references to a non-resolving domain
findings.description: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is unset in production; robots.ts:5, sitemap.ts:5 and [locale]/layout.tsx:30 fall back to https://vincent-desbrosses.com, which returns NXDOMAIN. This poisons canonical, hreflang, og:url, og:image and all 4 sitemap URLs.
findings.recommendation: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://vincent.desbrosses.net in Vercel for all environments and update the three hardcoded fallbacks.

findings.title: Every sub-page canonicalises to the locale homepage
findings.description: generateMetadata is defined only in [locale]/layout.tsx with canonical: ${baseUrl}/${locale}. Layout metadata is inherited, so /en/integration declares /en as its canonical.
findings.recommendation: Remove canonical from the layout; set it per route in each page.tsx.

findings.title: HTTP 500 on unmatched single-segment dotted paths
findings.description: /llms.txt, /foo.txt, /ads.txt, /favicon.png, /sitemap.xml.gz all return 500 with x-matched-path: /[locale]. The middleware matcher excludes dotted paths, so they match [locale]; layout.tsx:113 then does await import(`../../i18n/${locale}.json`) with an unvalidated param and throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
findings.recommendation: Add a locales allowlist check calling notFound() before the import, and create src/app/not-found.tsx (none exists).

findings.title: robots.txt Disallow rule matches nothing
findings.description: Disallow: /integration cannot match /en/integration or /fr/integration because robots.txt matches by prefix. Both pages return 200 with no noindex meta, and are simultaneously listed in sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Decide the intent: either add robots:{index:false} to the route and drop it from the sitemap, or remove the Disallow and give the page unique metadata.

findings.title: Security headers largely absent
findings.description: Only HSTS is present (max-age=63072000, without includeSubDomains or preload). X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are all missing.
findings.recommendation: Add a headers() block to next.config.mjs (this project uses .mjs, not .js).

findings.title: Locale routes are not statically pre-rendered
findings.description: No generateStaticParams in [locale]/layout.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Add generateStaticParams returning the locales to improve TTFB.

findings.title: Deprecated viewport declaration
findings.description: viewport is set inside the metadata object at layout.tsx:38. Next.js 14+ expects a separate `export const viewport`.
findings.recommendation: Move it to its own export.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 732 words (/en) and 844 (/fr) of genuine content
Complete, idiomatic FR localisation: 64/64 keys, zero missing, zero untranslated
Real 2007-2026 career timeline
Ten named projects with stack tags
Five first-person FAQ answers - strong Experience signal

findings.title: Authoritativeness is the weakest E-E-A-T axis
findings.description: Composite E-E-A-T 54/100, with Authoritativeness at 8/25: no testimonials, no client references, no Malt rating surfaced, no external citations.
findings.recommendation: Add client testimonials with names and companies, surface the Malt profile rating, and add a short factual bio naming years of experience and location.

findings.title: FR page serves English metadata
findings.description: Body content is fully translated, but title, description and og:title serve English on /fr. The French strings already exist in src/i18n/fr.json under metadata.* and are never read.
findings.recommendation: Read the metadata namespace via getTranslations in generateMetadata.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Exactly one H1 per page
Clean H1-H2-H3-H4 hierarchy with no skipped levels
Correct locale-aware <html lang>

findings.title: Generic title and description duplicated across all pages
findings.description: All three URLs return title 'Vincent's portfolio' and the same English description. The title carries no name-keyword, role or stack.
findings.recommendation: Use per-locale metadata and rewrite: 'Vincent Desbrosses - Freelance Fullstack Developer (React, Next.js, Node.js)' (76 chars).

findings.title: Only three crawlable links exist site-wide
findings.description: Raw server HTML for /en contains 3 hrefs: two hreflang alternates and one link to allaw.fr. LinkedIn, GitHub, X, Malt and the CV are all <button onClick={window.open(...)}> (Header.tsx:128-175). Neither CV PDF is linked, and there is no mailto:.
findings.recommendation: Replace with <a href target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer me"> keeping the same classes; link the CV directly. Fixes entity corroboration and WCAG 4.1.2 together.

findings.title: /en/integration has no H1
findings.description: grep -c '<h1' returns 0. The page also inherits the homepage title, description and canonical.
findings.recommendation: Give it a unique H1, title and description, or noindex it.

findings.title: FAQ block mis-nested in the heading outline
findings.description: The five FAQ questions render as H3 with no wrapping H2, so they are absorbed into the preceding 'H2: Journey' section - hiding the site's strongest first-person content.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the block in its own H2 using the existing faq.title key. Do not add FAQPage schema.

findings.title: Duplicate H3 text
findings.description: 'Allaw' appears as an H3 three times - twice consecutively under Projects, once under Journey.
findings.recommendation: Qualify each heading with its context.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: A well-formed Person object with jobTitle, knowsAbout and sameAs already exists in source

findings.title: No valid structured data reaches the page
findings.description: The Person schema is passed through Next Metadata's `other` field, which renders <meta name="application/ld+json" content="...">. The live page contains 0 occurrences of <script type="application/ld+json">. Its url and image fields also point at the dead domain.
findings.recommendation: Render a real <script type="application/ld+json"> in the component tree. Add Person, WebSite and ProfilePage; include Malt in sameAs.

findings.title: FAQPage schema not recommended
findings.description: FAQ content is live-rendered, but Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 2026-05-07, so there is no SERP benefit. The content is not genuine user Q&A, so QAPage does not apply either.
findings.recommendation: No action. Fix the heading nesting instead.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0
TBT 70ms
340KB / 20 requests total
Zero third-party requests
Hero image correctly preloaded with priority

findings.title: LCP marginally over threshold
findings.description: LCP 2.53s against a 2.5s good threshold. LAB DATA ONLY (Lighthouse 13.4.1, mobile, simulated throttling, single run) - no CrUX field data because no Google API key is configured. Server response time was fast at 33ms.
findings.recommendation: Add a Google API key to get field data before optimising; the lab number is within run-to-run noise of the threshold.

findings.title: LCP element could not be attributed
findings.description: Lighthouse returned null for lcp-breakdown-insight, lcp-discovery-insight and largest-contentful-paint-element in this run.
findings.recommendation: Re-measure with field data.

findings.title: JS is 64% of page weight
findings.description: 216KB across 11 requests. Verify FontAwesome is tree-shaken.
findings.recommendation: Audit the FontAwesome import style.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All major AI crawlers permitted (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Bingbot)
732 words of real content present in raw server HTML without JS execution

findings.title: No machine-readable identity
findings.description: No valid JSON-LD and no crawlable sameAs anchors, so nothing corroborates that this site, the LinkedIn profile and the GitHub account are the same entity.
findings.recommendation: Fix the JSON-LD script tag and convert social buttons to anchors.

findings.title: Sitemap points at a dead host
findings.description: The robots.txt Sitemap: directive and all 4 sitemap URLs name vincent-desbrosses.com, impairing crawler URL discovery.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by setting NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

findings.title: Weak passage-level citability
findings.description: Content is largely UI labels and skill chips rather than self-contained factual passages. Boilerplate-stripping extractors keep only ~970 of ~5000 visible characters.
findings.recommendation: Add a short factual bio paragraph and surface the FAQ answers as prose.

findings.title: /llms.txt returns 500
findings.description: Server error rather than a clean 404. Note llms.txt is not consumed by Google Search and adoption is unproven.
findings.recommendation: Fix the 500 first; publishing a static llms.txt is optional and low priority.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 11 Image components have alt text
sizes set on all responsive images
priority on the hero image
AVIF/WebP enabled in next.config.mjs
Measured CLS of 0

findings.title: OG image has the wrong aspect ratio
findings.description: pp.jpg is 819x823 (near-square) but is served for a summary_large_image card, which expects 1200x630. It will be centre-cropped on LinkedIn and X. It also currently fails to load because it is referenced on the dead domain.
findings.recommendation: Export a dedicated 1200x630 card; consider opengraph-image.tsx for per-locale cards.

findings.title: Large unoptimised source images
findings.description: public/ holds 25MB, largest 3.8MB (wildersgame.jpg), 3.2MB (codemaster.png). next/image optimises what it serves (43KB on the wire), so this is a repo-weight and build-time concern rather than a delivery one.
findings.recommendation: Pre-compress sources before committing.

categories.name: Visual / Rendering
what_works: Strong mobile above-the-fold: photo, name, role, value prop and 6 CTAs visible without scrolling
Dark mode contrast good, no invisible text
No horizontal overflow at any viewport
No above-the-fold layout shift between early and settled paint

findings.title: Page renders visually blank without JavaScript
findings.description: AOS ships [data-aos^=fade][data-aos^=fade]{opacity:0} and only reveals content when JS adds .aos-animate. NOTE: the text itself IS in the raw HTML (732 words verified), so crawlers still read the content - this is a UX and resilience risk, not an indexing emergency.
findings.recommendation: Add a <noscript> override setting [data-aos]{opacity:1} so a JS failure cannot blank the page.

findings.title: Hero CTA touch targets under 48px
findings.description: Buttons are 40px tall; width is fine.
findings.recommendation: Increase to 48px minimum.

findings.title: Theme/language menu behaviour unverified
findings.description: Scripted clicks produced no visible change across two attempts; this may be a harness hit-testing artefact rather than a real defect.
findings.recommendation: Manually verify the menu opens.
